findings.title: Source staging accepts symlinked source-root and intermediate source components
findings.contract: The source-provisioning method says the helper rejects every symlink component before copying the two gitignored source trees into an isolated repository worktree.

evidence.detail: The documented staging contract explicitly says every symlink component is rejected.
require_regular_tree() checks only the final tree path and entries yielded beneath it; it never lstat-walks the source-side path components leading to that tree.
The user-supplied source root is resolved before is_symlink() is checked. Path.resolve() removes the supplied symlink identity, so a symlinked --source-root cannot be rejected by this check.
Files reached through an intermediate source-side symlink are hashed and copied normally once require_regular_tree() accepts the resolved leaf paths.

observed: sourceRootSymlink: returncode=0, accepted=true, 2 files copied; output silently reported the resolved real directory instead of rejecting the supplied symlink alias
sourceIntermediateSymlink: returncode=0, accepted=true, 2 files copied through a symlinked source/docs component
sourceLeafSymlink: returncode=1 and source tree contains a symlink
targetIntermediateSymlink: returncode=1 and target path contains a symlink
trackedOverwrite: returncode=1, tracked candidate differs from source root; the before/after SHA-256 remained 7fb2721b02d3582869a91d8521a5d246a7e6bbf2b4d2413fd0af058136149dd4

findings.impact: An explicit source checkout can be supplied through a symlink alias, or one of its source-tree ancestors can redirect traversal to another directory. The helper will hash and copy the redirected bytes and report the resolved destination, defeating the stated no-symlink provenance boundary. Hash verification then proves only consistency with the redirected source, not that the intended lexical source checkout supplied the bytes.
minimalFix: Validate the lexical --source-root with lstat semantics before resolving it, walking every existing component from the filesystem root and rejecting any symlink.
For each SOURCE_TREES path, lstat-walk every source-relative ancestor and every traversed entry; do not rely only on tree.is_symlink() after an ancestor may already have redirected resolution.

Add focused controls for a symlinked --source-root, symlinked source/docs and source/assets ancestors, direct tree symlinks, leaf symlinks, target-side symlinks, and a differing tracked target whose bytes must remain unchanged.

findings.title: The exact every-checkpoint validator command cannot pass in the documented prelock state
findings.contract: The Stage 1 method must give an exact, reproducible command set for the current prelock gate. The project status says no v2 lock exists, and the separate prelock command is expected to permit that one setup state.

evidence.detail: The prelock command correctly includes --prelock, while the text says to omit that option only after audit-lock.json is committed.
The subsequent command block is labeled At every checkpoint but invokes validate_correctness_audit.py without --prelock.
The current phase is explicitly prelock and no v2 lock exists.
Without --prelock, main() calls validate(require_lock=True), so the documented every-checkpoint command necessarily requires audit-lock.json.

reproduction.failingObserved: returncode=1, passed=false, failureCount=1: audit-lock.json is required after setup checkpoint

findings.impact: A reviewer or integrator following all commands literally cannot produce an all-green checkpoint before the lock exists. The ambiguity can cause a false blocker, encourage skipping a declared required command, or lead operators to run the wrong gate for the lifecycle state.
minimalFix: Split the checkpoint block into exact prelock and post-lock command matrices, or show --prelock in the prelock matrix and explicitly state that it is removed only after the direct-child lock commit.
Keep create_correctness_audit_lock.py's isolated prelock argv identical to the documented prelock command and retain the existing command-shape unit test.
Add a documentation/command smoke check that executes the full declared prelock command set in a lock-free isolated worktree and requires every expected gate to be green.
